title: The Princess Bride
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Universes Beyond Secret Lair drops)

paragraphs.text: The Spookydrop 2023 is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It was available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com from October 2 to November 19, 2023.
The Superdrop contains eight drops , including one in the Artist Series and five drops in the Universes Beyond series.
The drops can be bought separately or in one of eight bundles, notably all missing the The Evil Dead drop.

The Fill My Cauldron with Almost Everything Bundle contains almost all cards in foil and non-foil for $372.74. The Fill My Cauldron with Non-Foils Bundle contains the non-foils of seven drops for $166.24 and the Fill My Cauldron with Foils Bundle (all foils of seven drops) costs $218.75. The Fill My Cauldron with Dr. Who Bundle contains only the Doctor Who themed cards (both foil and non-foil) for $110.00.. The Cards in Costume Bundles contain the John Avon , Princess Bride and Meditations on Nature drops (foil $93.75 and non-foil $71.25). The Places to Trick or Treat Lands Bundles contain The Dalek Lands , Meditations on Nature and PixelLands_v02.jpg (foil $93.75 and non-foil $71.25).

As an extra, each drop comes with a surprise bonus card. Except for the cases listed below, a potential bonus card for these drops is an extended art Jaspera Sentinel , Nettle Sentinel or Shaman of the Pack . This is the first Superdrop to replace Extended art Slivers with Extended art Elves for the "common" bonus cards.
